data.reduces_to_open_conjecture: conj:dilogarithm-archimedean-limit (Bloch-Suslin archimedean π) + explicit 2πg identity on Bring
data.verdict: The 1/π per-mode weight is NOT derivable from the flat ζ-determinant: det'(−∂²)_{S¹}(L)=L² exactly (the 2π cancels), scale-dependent and μ-absorbable — the naive per-mode-weight route is the spec-§3 fitting trap, RULED OUT (scope-(a)). A μ-independent 1/π must be topological. The proved 1/(12π) template's π IS topological — Gauss–Bonnet 2πχ (Area=12π) — but the loop measure is 1/(8π)=1/(2π·g), whose π needs a GENUS (2πg) source, DISTINCT from the template's Euler-char (2πχ). So 1/(8π) is not the same geometric identity as 2/(3π); it does not close by ζ-determinant bookkeeping. The framework's canonical μ-independent π is the archimedean dilogarithm regulator (Bloch–Suslin pentagon-uniqueness → Bloch–Wigner D; conj:dilogarithm-archimedean-limit). CONCLUSION: closing 1/(8π) reduces to that named open conjecture PLUS an explicit 2π·g (genus) identity on Bring's surface — the b₁ count (PR #3831) is topological, but the 1/π per-mode weight is not forced by the ζ-determinant alone. No fit; nothing wired; not reverse-engineered to 8π.
